metadata.architecture: Frozen SigLIP-SO400M + Motion-Difference Stream + Articulator Saliency Pooling + Contrastive Semantic Anchoring

qualitative_corrections.entity_grounding: Correct calendar dates and days recovered through temporal differential motion trajectories (e.g. 15th Oktober correctly translated instead of hallucinated 30th Mai).
qualitative_corrections.background_filtering: Articulator-aware pooling suppresses studio backdrop and focuses token budget on moving hands and face.
qualitative_corrections.hallucination_reduction: Contrastive InfoNCE loss grounds visual features to target semantics, stopping false generations like 'rain in the north' when absent in reference.
